disclaimer: Exploratory affinity to 1000 Genomes Phase 3 reference populations (Ensembl allele frequencies). Not ethnicity, nationality, or tribal identity. 1000 Genomes has no dedicated Iranian/Levant/North-Africa panels — West Asian genomes often look closest to South Asian (GIH/ITU/PJL) and/or Southern European (TSI/IBS) references.
method_summary: Bars are normalized genotype likelihoods against 1000 Genomes analysis populations, then rolled up into continental regions. More markers than the old 31-SNP panel, but still not a consumer ethnicity estimate.
